messages:
Marta (People Ops): Hi team — Sam submitted an accommodation request about heat sensitivity and workplace migraines. Sam, can you summarize what accommodations you're requesting and any timeline?
Sam Lee: Sure. Short version: office seating near the server room / central vents makes migraines worse. Requesting a 4-week trial: remote 3 days/week (Mon/Wed/Fri), in-office Tue/Thu with flexible starts (around 10am). Also asking for a small desk fan and a low-noise HEPA purifier at my desk.
Daniel Chen (Eng Manager): Thanks for flagging this, Sam. Two immediate team concerns: 1) new hires start next week and we rely on in-person pairing, 2) sprint planning syncs are at 9:30a. Would Tue/Thu in-office be ok? I can also move the team sync to 10:15 while Sam's trial runs.
Sam Lee: Tue/Thu in-office works. Moving the sync later helps a lot. Remote days are important because symptoms can hit without warning.
Marta (People Ops): We'll treat this as a Temporary Accommodation Trial for 4 weeks, documented in our system. We'll note the start/end dates and equipment requests. Priya, any EEO guidance?
Priya (EEO): That plan is appropriate. Reminder to keep medical details private; only share what's necessary (manager + HR + facilities for equipment). Also offer Sam the option to provide medical documentation but do not require it for a short trial.
Facilities Bot: Facilities ticket created: FT-9921 — Request: small clip fan + low-noise HEPA purifier for desk area. ETA 5 business days.
Daniel Chen (Eng Manager): I'll rearrange pairings so new hires get overlap with other mentors on Sam's remote days. I'll also draft a short ramp plan for the next 4 weeks and set a weekly 30-min check-in with Sam.
Sam Lee: Appreciate that. Also would prefer a clip fan to be out of direct view (sensitivity to motion) if possible.
Marta (People Ops): Noted. Next steps: 1) I'll create the formal trial record and share start date, 2) Facilities will fulfill the equipment order, 3) Daniel and Sam to set the weekly check-in and share the ramp goals doc. We'll reconvene after 4 weeks to decide next steps (extend, modify, or make permanent).
Sam Lee: Thank you — feeling relieved to have a concrete plan.
Priya (EEO): One more note: for the evaluation, keep notes focused on objective factors (attendance on in-office days, ramp goal progress). Avoid subjective language about health.
Marta (People Ops): Absolutely. I'll post the official confirmation and close the loop here. :white_check_mark:
